$schema.description: Path to the JSON Schema file used by editors for validation and completion.

language.description: Output language. Use 'auto' to preserve the audio language, or a BCP 47 locale such as 'en-US', 'en-GB', 'it-IT', 'de-DE', 'fr-FR', 'es-ES', 'nl-NL', or 'pl-PL'.

target_length.description: Target article-body length: short (500-700 words), medium (800-1,000 words), or long (1,200-1,800 words). The source must support the requested length without repetition or invented details.

proper_noun_hints.description: Names, brands, places, or terms that must be spelled correctly.

constraints.description: Additional editorial instructions for generated content.
default: Use clear headings and short paragraphs.
